init: Four crew. One pre-landed habitat. No resupply.
The MDV is on the surface. The hard-shell habitat is already assembled.
The inflatable inner shelter, power plant, and life-support equipment remain packed.
The MDV battery and oxygen stores can sustain the crew for at most seven sols.
setup: ?SETUP // 1 Unpack cargo  2 Inflate inner shelter  3 Select power  4 Install life support  5 Wait one sol  6 Status  7 Deploy base  8 Abort >
setup_unpack: You unpack the cargo containers. The equipment is now accessible.
setup_inflate: The crew inflates and seals the soft inner shelter inside the printed hard-shell structure.
Cargo must be unpacked before the inner shelter can be assembled.
choose_power: ?POWER PLANT // 1 Remote nuclear reactor (high output, difficult repairs)  2 Solar array (nearby, dust vulnerable) >
choose_nuclear: The nuclear reactor is deployed at a remote site. It produces more power but is difficult to reach for repairs.
choose_solar: The solar array is deployed beside the habitat. It is easier to maintain, but Martian dust frequently blocks it.
setup_life_support: The crew installs atmospheric oxygen extraction, CO2 scrubbing, water extraction and recycling, and the crop unit.
Subsurface ice is extracted for the initial water reserve. This is power-intensive.
A power source must be selected before life support can be installed.
Inflate the inner shelter before installing life support.
Unpack the cargo before installing life support.
setup_wait: One sol passes while the crew works inside the MDV.
The MDV battery is exhausted before the habitat is ready.
The MDV oxygen reserve is exhausted before the habitat is ready.
The MDV remains operational, but its reserves are shrinking.
setup_deploy: The habitat is commissioned. The crew transfers from the MDV into the base.
A power plant has not been selected.
The inflatable inner shelter is not assembled.
invalid_choice: Invalid selection. Choose one of the listed options.

mode_extractor: Atmospheric extraction is enabled. Oxygen production improves, but electrical demand rises.
mode_scrubber: The CO2 scrubber is enabled. It uses less power, but does not replace oxygen consumed by the crew.

final_review: MISSION COMPLETE // Thirty sols have elapsed. The crew prepares to board the Mars Ascent Vehicle.
MISSION SUCCESS // The crew returns aboard the MAV with the required science return and a two-week food reserve.
MISSION FAILURE // The scientific return or final food reserve is below mission requirements.
mission_success: All four astronauts survived. The MAV launches from Mars.
mission_failure: MISSION FAILURE // The mission can no longer meet its survival or operational requirements.
If the MAV remains available, the crew's emergency ascent is initiated where possible.
abort: MISSION ABORT // The crew abandons surface operations and prepares to ascend aboard the MAV.
The MAV carries independent power and oxygen.
